_comment: Real foreign-language speech for NPCs with no shared language. Every phrase is a real sentence in that tongue — never gibberish, never '[speaks Italian]'. Each entry: t (native text), en (translation, shown only via interpreter/translator/learning), kw (keyword glosses the player can catch while learning). fewWords: the handful of English fragments a zero-English speaker might know — the Mario energy.
